description: This file defines helper structures and functions for networking configuration, specifically parsing host:port strings and generating URL strings with fallback support.

methods.name: parseHostPort(from:)
methods.description: Parses a string to extract host and port information, returning a SettingsHostPort object if successful.

methods.name: httpURLString(host:port:fallback:)
methods.description: Generates an HTTP URL string based on provided host and port, or falls back to a default string.
